evidence.why_not_priced: The slip and the overrun burden have been public since 9-25 and the stock has halved since, so the known part is priced. Only a further slip is unpriced. evidence.text: The EPS bar ($0.38-0.43) sits above Q2's own adjusted EPS of $0.35 (adjusted net income $4.66M) on similar revenue. Q2 R&D rose 122.9% YoY and G&A 16.8%.
